description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80.  A black solid line with circular markers, labeled “Base”, begins at approximately (1, 63%) and increases to approximately (1000, 72%). A light-brown dashed line with diamond markers, labeled “MEND”, begins at approximately (1, 72%) and increases to approximately (1000, 78%). A blue dashed line with triangular markers, labeled “FT”, begins at approximately (1, 65%) and increases to approximately (1000, 72%). A red dashed line with triangular markers, labeled “IKE”, begins at approximately (1, 68%) and declines to approximately (1000, 70%). A green solid line with square markers, labeled “ROME”, begins at approximately (1, 74%) and increases to approximately (1000, 79%). A purple solid line with circular markers, labeled “MEMIT”, begins at approximately (1, 72%) and declines to approximately (1000, 75%).
